blocks.text: The leading newly prioritized issue is **CVE-2026-133469 (CVE-2026-133469)**, a critical authentication bypass flaw; it is described in its CVE record as exploited in the wild (not yet corroborated by CISA KEV, Project Zero, EUVD or VulnCheck). No fixed release is mapped in NVD data yet. **CVE-2026-134624 (N-able MailAssure)** is another important newly highlighted issue; it is listed in CISA KEV on 2026-11-23 (exploitation confirmed by CISA) and reported exploited by ENISA EUVD since 2026-11-23.

blocks.text: **Top five actions:** (1) Isolate or patch exposed CVE-2026-133469 (CVE-2026-133469); (2) isolate or patch exposed N-able MailAssure (CVE-2026-134624); (3) apply the vendor fix for CVE-2026-134815 (CVE-2026-134815); (4) validate remediation of MONAI Label CVE-2026-133968 and WhatsApp for Android CVE-2026-102769; (5) examine CVE-2026-133469 hosts for unauthorized administrative access and configuration changes.

**CVE-2026-133469 - CVE-2026-133469 authentication bypass (CVSS 9.8).** XO (Xen Orchestra) is a solution to visualize, manage, backup and delegate your XCP-ng (or XenServer) infrastructure. Prior to 6.9.2 and 6.10.1, REST cookie parsing turns authenticationToken=j:%7B%7D into {}. REST authentication passes that object to the XO token provider without requiring a string. The token collection treats {} as an unfiltered lookup and returns its first token;. Affected releases: not yet published in NVD configuration data. Fixed package release: none identified in tracked sources. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

blocks.text: **CVE-2026-134624 - N-able MailAssure server-side request forgery (CVSS 9.3).** N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) before 20261121.1943 does not restrict the destination of the LDAP synchronisation connection check performed when a relay is configured. An authenticated API user can cause the server to connect to arbitrary internal hosts and ports, determine which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services. Affected releases: not yet published in NVD configuration data. Fixed package release: none identified in tracked sources. Attack path: network-accessible; high-privileged authentication required; no user interaction required.

blocks.text: **CVE-2026-134815 - CVE-2026-134815 vulnerability (CVSS 9.2).** simple-git before 4.1.0 contains an argument injection vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass the allowUnsafePack guard by supplying the --exec option to non-push git operations. Attackers who influence arguments passed to listRemote() or raw() can inject --exec for ls-remote, archive, fetch-pack or send-pack to execute commands on the host. Affected releases: not yet published in NVD configuration data. Fixed package release: none identified in tracked sources. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

EPSS: 0.8% probability / 55th percentile (FIRST EPSS). CISA KEV: Not listed in latest verified baseline. Exploitation: No malicious exploitation confirmed by tracked sources. Public exploit code referenced: 1 unvetted GitHub repository; weaponized exploit not verified. Mitigation: Apply the vendor fix or mitigation; remove untrusted network reachability until patched; place the service behind authentication or a VPN; monitor for exploitation.

**CVE-2026-134814 - CVE-2026-134814 code injection (CVSS 9.2).** binary-parser before 2.3.1 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows attackers controlling parser definitions to inject JavaScript through string-typed options passed unvalidated by Context.generateOption(). Attackers can supply crafted length, lengthInBytes, key, tag, offset, or namely() alias values to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the Node.js process when the parser is compiled. Affected releases: not yet published in NVD configuration data. Fixed package release: none identified in tracked sources. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

EPSS: 0.6% probability / 50th percentile (FIRST EPSS). CISA KEV: Not listed in latest verified baseline. Exploitation: No malicious exploitation confirmed by tracked sources. Mitigation: Apply the vendor fix or mitigation; remove untrusted network reachability until patched; place the service behind authentication or a VPN; monitor for exploitation.

**CVE-2026-134838 - Weblate vulnerability (CVSS 9.1).** Weblate before 2026.11 contains an account takeover vulnerability in the reset_password view that allows unauthenticated attackers to reset victim passwords by abusing case-insensitive Unicode e-mail matching. Attackers controlling a lookalike mailbox using a dotless i or other case-folding variant receive the victim's reset link, since it is sent to the typed address, and set a new password. Affected releases: not yet published in NVD configuration data. Fixed package release: none identified in tracked sources. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

CVE-2026-134624 (N-able MailAssure): listed in CISA KEV on 2026-11-23 (exploitation confirmed by CISA) and reported exploited by ENISA EUVD since 2026-11-23. No named actor, verified victim count or campaign is established in tracked sources. No campaign-specific IP addresses, hashes or domains are collected by ThreatWatch's automated feeds.

No new CISA KEV additions were verified in the reporting window. The latest additions remain the 2 entries added November 23, 2026: Project MONAI MONAI Label and N-able MailAssure. The federal remediation deadline for those entries is **November 26, 2026**. This deadline applies to covered federal agencies under applicable requirements; it is not a universal private-sector mandate.

**Defensive hunting:** for CVE-2026-133469 (CVE-2026-133469), review administrative logins, newly created accounts or API tokens, and configuration changes made without a matching change record; for N-able MailAssure (CVE-2026-134624), review outbound requests from the service to internal addresses or cloud metadata endpoints; for CVE-2026-134815 (CVE-2026-134815), review the affected service's logs for unusual requests and changes around the disclosure date; for CVE-2026-134814 (CVE-2026-134814), inspect unexpected child processes of the service, new scheduled jobs or services, and unusual outbound connections from the host.
